unit: harmonized (MODIS-equivalent) detections per 1deg cell-month; errors in log1p space
note: skill = 1 - MSE_model/MSE_normal; <= 0 means no better than the seasonal normal. Direction hit rate only for cells with |predicted deviation| > 0.2 (chance = 0.5). Prototype: seasonality + persistence only, no weather/drought/fuel inputs; not a fire prediction.
